data.narrative:
Tandem PV is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Colin Bailie and Chris Eberspacher that has raised approximately $87M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with aligned valuation tiers to support a robust peer-median approach—filtering for relevant cohorts yielded fewer than three datapoints—rendering traditional multiples-based triangulation inapplicable.

Consequently, the valuation relies on stage-progression methodology, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage advancement to the $87M raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $174M. This method assumes the company has reached operational and financial milestones commensurate with Series A risk reduction and is positioned for growth capital at the next stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $148M to $200M, with $174M as the central estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of near-peer transaction data to calibrate stage-progression multiers to company-specific risk profiles and technology maturity within the perovskite or tandem solar sector. Further resolution requires either closer peer-stage alignment or disclosure of revenue, IP position, or technology readiness metrics.
